issues.description: The problem statement requires calling setup_env() with no parameters, but the template does not declare or call setup_env (missing extern), and the solution declares extern setup_env and calls it with one parameter (push 1) before call. This creates a signature/usage mismatch across artifacts and will confuse students about the correct calling convention and whether they must pass an argument.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the calling convention consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) update the problem statement to require a single integer argument for setup_env() and document the need to push that argument (and keep the solution as-is), or (B) change the solution to call setup_env() with no parameters (remove the push 1 / add esp, 4 around the call) and add an 'extern setup_env' declaration to the template so students can call it. Also add the 'extern setup_env' line to the template to avoid linkage confusion.
